standard_prerequisites.name: Separatedness of etale morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: etale morphisms of algebraic spaces are separated (cross-chapter, structural)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes all Cech fibre products separated, hence their affine etale covers have affine fibre products.

core_obligations: Let U be separated lfp over X: take an etale covering {U_i -> U} with U_i affine; by separatedness U_{i_0} x_U ... x_U U_{i_p} is affine, so P holds on it, and the Cech property gives P(U).
Choose a disjoint union of affines U -> X surjective etale; each U x_X ... x_X U (p+1 factors) is separated etale over X, hence P holds on all Cech terms.
Apply the Cech descent hypothesis to conclude P(X).
proof_roadmap: Separated-case descent to affines, then the disjoint-union presentation with affine Cech nerve.
difficulty_reason: Two-step descent with the separatedness observation doing real work in making every Cech term affine.
